q: 她在办公室给自己泡了一___热茶。
zh: 她在办公室给自己泡了一杯热茶。
py: tā zài bàn gōng shì gěi zì jǐ pào le yī bēi rè chá
en: She made herself a cup of hot tea in the office.
why: The cup is the measure for a drink: 一杯茶, with no 个. 双 is for pairs and 套 for sets.

q: 这___饭馆的面条很便宜，我们常去那儿吃午饭。
zh: 这家饭馆的面条很便宜，我们常去那儿吃午饭。
py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de miàn tiáo hěn pián yi wǒ men cháng qù nà r chī wǔ fàn
en: The noodles at this restaurant are cheap; we often have lunch there.
why: A restaurant is a business, and businesses take 家. 间 is for rooms, 座 for big fixed structures, 层 for floors.

s: 我每个星期有两节汉语课，每个月还要考一次试。
s_py: wǒ měi gè xīng qī yǒu liǎng jié hàn yǔ kè měi gè yuè hái yào kǎo yī cì shì
zh: 我每个星期有两节汉语课，每个月还要考一次试。
py: wǒ měi gè xīng qī yǒu liǎng jié hàn yǔ kè měi gè yuè hái yào kǎo yī cì shì
en: I have two Chinese classes every week and a test every month.
why: 星期 and 月 take 个 after 每, while 节 counts class periods and 次 counts tests, so every measure here is right.

s: 我买了一个蛋糕给同事过生日，大家都很开心。
s_py: wǒ mǎi le yí gè dàn gāo gěi tóng shì guò shēng rì dà jiā dōu hěn kāi xīn
zh: 我买了一个蛋糕给同事过生日，大家都很开心。
py: wǒ mǎi le yí gè dàn gāo gěi tóng shì guò shēng rì dà jiā dōu hěn kāi xīn
en: I bought a cake for a colleague's birthday and everyone was happy.
why: A whole cake is 一个蛋糕; 块 would count a piece of it. 个 is correct here.

zh: 我学了三个月汉语。
py: wǒ xué le sān gè yuè hàn yǔ
en: I studied Chinese for three months.
why: Duration goes after the verb: 三个月. 月 needs 个 when counting months.

s: 那几本书都是我从学校借来的。
s_py: nà jǐ běn shū dōu shì wǒ cóng xué xiào jiè lái de
zh: 那几本书都是我从学校借来的。
py: nà jǐ běn shū dōu shì wǒ cóng xué xiào jiè lái de
en: Those few books were all borrowed from the school by me.
why: 几 can stand in the number slot after 那: 那 + 几 + 本 + 书 is correct. It looks unusual but follows the normal order.

q: 学校组织我们去农场参观，那里养了二十___牛。
zh: 学校组织我们去农场参观，那里养了二十头牛。
py: xué xiào zǔ zhī wǒ men qù nóng chǎng cān guān nà lǐ yǎng le èr shí tóu niú
en: The school took us to visit a farm where they keep twenty cows.
why: Cattle take 头. 只 is for small animals, 匹 for horses and 条 for fish.

s: 老师让我们每个人唱一首中文歌。
s_py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men měi gè rén chàng yī shǒu zhōng wén gē
zh: 老师让我们每个人唱一首中文歌。
py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men měi gè rén chàng yī shǒu zhōng wén gē
en: The teacher asked each of us to sing a Chinese song.
why: Songs take 首, and 每个人 is correct because 个 follows 每 before 人.

s: 我昨天把三这份文件都交给了经理。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ sān zhè fèn wén jiàn dōu jiāo gěi le jīng lǐ
zh: 我昨天把这三份文件都交给了经理。
py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ zhè sān fèn wén jiàn dōu jiāo gěi le jīng lǐ
en: Yesterday I handed all three of these documents to the manager.
why: The pointing word comes before the number: 这三份文件. 三这份 reverses it, which is impossible.

q: 我昨天在学校的书店买了三___书。
zh: 我昨天在学校的书店买了三本书。
py: wǒ zuó tiān zài xué xiào de shū diàn mǎi le sān běn shū
en: I bought three books at the school bookstore yesterday.
why: A number cannot sit directly on a noun, so 三书 is wrong. Books are bound volumes and take 本; 条 is for long bendy things.

q: 他在河边钓了三___大鱼，第二天带到公司给同事们看。
zh: 他在河边钓了三条大鱼，第二天带到公司给同事们看。
py: tā zài hé biān diào le sān tiáo dà yú dì èr tiān dài dào gōng sī gěi tóng shì men kàn
en: He caught three big fish by the river and took them to the office the next day to show his colleagues.
why: Fish take 条. 只 is for small land animals and birds, 头 for cattle, 匹 for horses.

q: 我们班每___学生都有一本词典。
zh: 我们班每个学生都有一本词典。
py: wǒ men bān měi gè xué shēng dōu yǒu yī běn cí diǎn
en: Every student in our class has a dictionary.
why: 每 must be followed by a measure word, and 学生 takes 个. 每学生 drops it the English way; 些 and 本 do not fit people.

q: 教室外面站着一___学生，等着见老师。
zh: 教室外面站着一些学生，等着见老师。
py: jiào shì wài miàn zhàn zhe yī xiē xué shēng děng zhe jiàn lǎo shī
en: A few students are standing outside the classroom, waiting to see the teacher.
why: The English cue says several students, so 一些学生. 一个 would mean just one student; 一点儿 is only for things that cannot be counted.

zh: 这家饭馆的菜很好吃。
py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài hěn hǎo chī
en: The food at this restaurant is delicious.
why: 这 + 家 + noun forms the phrase, then 的 links it to 菜. 家 must follow 这 and precede 饭馆.

q: 我家有四___人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
zh: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
py: wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén ： bà bà 、 mā mā 、 gē gē hé wǒ
en: There are four people in my family: Dad, Mum, my brother and me.
why: Members of a family are counted with 口. 间 is for rooms, 座 for bridges and mountains, 层 for floors.

q: 她用两个星期读完了那___长篇小说。
zh: 她用两个星期读完了那部长篇小说。
py: tā yòng liǎng gè xīng qī dú wán le nà bù cháng piān xiǎo shuō
en: She finished that long novel in two weeks.
why: A novel takes 部. 首 is for songs, 节 for class periods and 场 for events.

q: 我们公司在十___，你坐电梯上来吧。
zh: 我们公司在十层，你坐电梯上来吧。
py: wǒ men gōng sī zài shí céng nǐ zuò diàn tī shàng lái ba
en: Our company is on the tenth floor, so take the lift up.
why: Floors of a building take 层. 间 counts rooms, 家 counts businesses, 座 counts whole buildings.

q: 她在晚会上唱了一___中文歌。
zh: 她在晚会上唱了一首中文歌。
py: tā zài wǎn huì shàng chàng le yī shǒu zhōng wén gē
en: She sang a Chinese song at the party.
why: Songs and poems take 首. 部 is for films and novels, 节 for classes and 场 for events.

zh: 请你再说一遍。
py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn
en: Please say it once more.
why: The counter 一遍 goes after the verb 说, not before it.

zh: 他每天睡八个小时。
py: tā měi tiān shuì bā gè xiǎo shí
en: He sleeps eight hours every day.
why: 每天 takes no 个, but 八个小时 does. The time word may come before or after the subject, and the duration stays after the verb.

q: 这___水果我没吃过，叫什么名字？
zh: 这种水果我没吃过，叫什么名字？
py: zhè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ wǒ méi chī guò jiào shén me míng zì
en: I have never eaten this kind of fruit; what is it called?
why: Kinds of things are counted with 种. 首, 部 and 场 count songs, films and events.

q: ___三本书都是老师借给我的。
zh: 这三本书都是老师借给我的。
py: zhè sān běn shū dōu shì lǎo shī jiè gěi wǒ de
en: These three books were all lent to me by the teacher.
why: The order is pointing word + number + measure + noun. 这个 or 那些 cannot be stacked in front of 三本; only a bare 这 fits before the number.

q: 这___课有四个学分，所以我们不能不及格。
zh: 这门课有四个学分，所以我们不能不及格。
py: zhè mén kè yǒu sì gè xué fēn suǒ yǐ wǒ men bù néng bù jí gé
en: This course carries four credits, so we cannot afford to fail.
why: Credits belong to a course as a subject, which is counted with 门. 节 would mean a single class period.

q: 她在银行找到了一___很不错的工作。
zh: 她在银行找到了一份很不错的工作。
py: tā zài yín háng zhǎo dào le yī fèn hěn bú cuò de gōng zuò
en: She found a pretty good job at a bank.
why: A job is counted with 份. 家 is for the company itself, not the post, and 座 and 本 do not fit work.

q: 医生让我每天吃两___药，吃完饭以后再吃。
zh: 医生让我每天吃两片药，吃完饭以后再吃。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ měi tiān chī liǎng piàn yào chī wán fàn yǐ hòu zài chī
en: The doctor told me to take two tablets a day, after meals.
why: Thin tablets are counted with 片. 块 is for solid chunks, 张 for large flat things and 朵 for flowers.

q: 公司晚上请客户吃了一___饭。
zh: 公司晚上请客户吃了一顿饭。
py: gōng sī wǎn shàng qǐng kè hù chī le yī dùn fàn
en: The company took the client out for a meal in the evening.
why: A meal is counted with 顿. 场 is for events like matches and rain, 节 and 门 for classes.

q: 桌子上放着三___笔。
zh: 桌子上放着三支笔。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe sān zhī bǐ
en: There are three pens on the desk.
why: Pens take 支. 把 is for things with a handle, 条 for long bendy things and 张 for flat sheets.

q: 我们的公司在上海有两___分公司，在北京还有一家。
zh: 我们的公司在上海有两家分公司，在北京还有一家。
py: wǒ men de gōng sī zài shàng hǎi yǒu liǎng jiā fēn gōng sī zài běi jīng hái yǒu yī jiā
en: Our company has two branches in Shanghai and one more in Beijing.
why: Companies and branches are businesses and take 家. 间 counts rooms, 座 counts buildings, 层 counts floors.

q: 关于这___事，我们明天开会再讨论。
zh: 关于这件事，我们明天开会再讨论。
py: guān yú zhè jiàn shì wǒ men míng tiān kāi huì zài tǎo lùn
en: As for this matter, we will discuss it at tomorrow's meeting.
why: 件 counts matters and affairs as well as tops. 条 would only fit a road or a rule, 张 and 把 do not fit 事.

s: 我去过三遍上海。
s_py: wǒ qù guò sān biàn shàng hǎi
zh: 我去过三次上海。
py: wǒ qù guò sān cì shàng hǎi
en: I have been to Shanghai three times.
why: 遍 means going through something from start to finish. Visits to a city are counted with 次.

q: 他在北京学了三___年中文。
zh: 他在北京学了三年中文。
py: tā zài běi jīng xué le sān nián zhōng wén
en: He studied Chinese in Beijing for three years.
why: 年 is a measure word on its own: 三年, with no 个. 三个年 is wrong.

q: 我请了三___天假，下星期一回来上班，请大家别担心。
zh: 我请了三天假，下星期一回来上班，请大家别担心。
py: wǒ qǐng le sān tiān jià xià xīng qī yī huí lái shàng bān qǐng dà jiā bié dān xīn
en: I have taken three days of leave and will be back at work next Monday, so please don't worry.
why: 天 is itself a measure word, so 三天假 takes no 个. 三个天 is wrong.

q: 今天上午我们有四___课，从八点上到十二点。
zh: 今天上午我们有四节课，从八点上到十二点。
py: jīn tiān shàng wǔ wǒ men yǒu sì jié kè cóng bā diǎn shàng dào shí èr diǎn
en: We have four classes this morning, from eight to twelve.
why: Class periods on the timetable take 节; running from eight to twelve fills four periods. 门 would mean four different subjects.

q: 这些___书都是图书馆的，不能带回家。
zh: 这些书都是图书馆的，不能带回家。
py: zhè xiē shū dōu shì tú shū guǎn de bù néng dài huí jiā
en: These books all belong to the library and cannot be taken home.
why: 这些 already fills the measure position, so the noun follows directly: 这些书.

s: 我家有三口人，住在学校附近。
s_py: wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén zhù zài xué xiào fù jìn
zh: 我家有三口人，住在学校附近。
py: wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén zhù zài xué xiào fù jìn
en: There are three of us in my family and we live near the school.
why: 口 is the measure for family members, so 三口人 is correct, though learners expect 个.

s: 我在这家公司工作了两个年。
s_py: wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le liǎng gè nián
zh: 我在这家公司工作了两年。
py: wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le liǎng nián
en: I have worked at this company for two years.
why: 年 is a measure itself, so it takes no 个: 两年.

q: 我们的暑假只有两___月，不太长。
zh: 我们的暑假只有两个月，不太长。
py: wǒ men de shǔ jià zhǐ yǒu liǎng gè yuè bù tài cháng
en: Our summer holiday is only two months, not very long.
why: Counting months needs 个: 两个月. Without it 两月 would read as 'February'.

s: 桌上有一个杯子，里面有一杯热茶。
s_py: zhuō shàng yǒu yí gè bēi zi lǐ miàn yǒu yī bēi rè chá
zh: 桌上有一个杯子，里面有一杯热茶。
py: zhuō shàng yǒu yí gè bēi zi lǐ miàn yǒu yī bēi rè chá
en: There is a cup on the table with a cup of hot tea in it.
why: The cup as an object takes 个 (一个杯子), while the tea inside is counted with 杯 (一杯热茶). Both are correct.

q: 我第一___见到李老师是在大学开学那天。
zh: 我第一次见到李老师是在大学开学那天。
py: wǒ dì yī cì jiàn dào lǐ lǎo shī shì zài dà xué kāi xué nà tiān
en: The first time I saw Teacher Li was on the first day of university.
why: 第一次 is the fixed way to say 'the first time'. 遍 and 趟 would need a text or a trip.

q: 王总，我给您介绍一下，这___是我们部门的新经理。
zh: 王总，我给您介绍一下，这位是我们部门的新经理。
py: wáng zǒng wǒ gěi nín jiè shào yī xià zhè wèi shì wǒ men bù mén de xīn jīng lǐ
en: Mr Wang, let me introduce you: this is our department's new manager.
why: Introducing a person respectfully to 您 calls for polite 位. 口, 家 and 间 are for family members, businesses and rooms.

q: 老师给我们看了一张照片，上面有一___马在河边吃草。
zh: 老师给我们看了一张照片，上面有一匹马在河边吃草。
py: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men kàn le yī zhāng zhào piān shàng miàn yǒu yì pǐ mǎ zài hé biān chī cǎo
en: The teacher showed us a photo of a horse eating grass by the river.
why: Horses take 匹. 头 is for cattle and pigs, and 只 or 条 cannot be used for a horse.

s: 会议室里坐着五位人。
s_py: huì yì shì lǐ zuò zhe wǔ wèi rén
zh: 会议室里坐着五个人。
py: huì yì shì lǐ zuò zhe wǔ gè rén
en: Five people are sitting in the meeting room.
why: 位 is never used with the bare noun 人; say 五个人. 位 needs a role word such as 客人 or 老师.

q: 他早饭吃了两___米饭。
zh: 他早饭吃了两碗米饭。
py: tā zǎo fàn chī le liǎng wǎn mǐ fàn
en: He ate two bowls of rice for breakfast.
why: Rice is served in a bowl, so 碗. 杯 is for drinks in cups, 瓶 for bottles, 双 for pairs.

q: 我有点渴，想喝一点儿___水。
zh: 我有点渴，想喝一点儿水。
py: wǒ yǒu diǎn kě xiǎng hē yī diǎn r shuǐ
en: I'm a bit thirsty, I'd like a little water.
why: 一点儿 goes straight onto the noun, so 一点儿水. Adding 杯, 瓶 or 个 after it is wrong.

q: 从公司到我家要经过一___很长的桥，所以下雨天特别堵车。
zh: 从公司到我家要经过一座很长的桥，所以下雨天特别堵车。
py: cóng gōng sī dào wǒ jiā yào jīng guò yī zuò hěn cháng de qiáo suǒ yǐ xià yǔ tiān tè bié dǔ chē
en: To get from the company to my home you cross a very long bridge, so traffic is terrible on rainy days.
why: Bridges take 座. 间 is for rooms, 家 for businesses, 层 for floors, and none describes a bridge.

q: 学校门口有两___大树，夏天很凉快。
zh: 学校门口有两棵大树，夏天很凉快。
py: xué xiào mén kǒu yǒu liǎng kē dà shù xià tiān hěn liáng kuài
en: There are two big trees at the school gate; it's cool there in summer.
why: Trees and plants take 棵. 朵 is for flowers and 片 for slices or open areas, so neither fits a tree.

q: 上个月公司招了一些___新同事，办公室一下子热闹起来。
zh: 上个月公司招了一些新同事，办公室一下子热闹起来。
py: shàng gè yuè gōng sī zhāo le yī xiē xīn tóng shì bàn gōng shì yī xià zi rè nào qǐ lái
en: The company hired some new colleagues last month and the office suddenly became lively.
why: 一些 fills the measure slot, so no 位, 个 or 名 follows. 一些位同事 is wrong.

q: 你们班有几___学生？
zh: 你们班有几个学生？
py: nǐ men bān yǒu jǐ gè xué shēng
en: How many students are there in your class?
why: 几 is a number word, so it needs a measure before the noun. 学生 takes 个; 几学生 without it is not standard and 些 cannot follow 几.

q: 老板去上海出差，一个月要跑好几___。
zh: 老板去上海出差，一个月要跑好几趟。
py: lǎo bǎn qù shàng hǎi chū chāi yí gè yuè yào pǎo hǎo jǐ tàng
en: The boss travels to Shanghai on business and makes several trips a month.
why: A journey there and back is a 趟. 遍 needs content to run through, and 个 or 层 do not count trips.

s: 老板新买了一部手机，还换了一台电脑。
s_py: lǎo bǎn xīn mǎi le yī bù shǒu jī hái huàn le yī tái diàn nǎo
zh: 老板新买了一部手机，还换了一台电脑。
py: lǎo bǎn xīn mǎi le yī bù shǒu jī hái huàn le yī tái diàn nǎo
en: The boss bought a new phone and also replaced his computer.
why: Phones take 部 and computers take 台, so both are right even though they look alike.

q: 昨天我们看了一___很有意思的电影。
zh: 昨天我们看了一部很有意思的电影。
py: zuó tiān wǒ men kàn le yī bù hěn yǒu yì si de diàn yǐng
en: Yesterday we watched a very interesting film.
why: A film as a work takes 部. 首 is for songs, 节 for class periods and 门 for courses.

q: 请给我一点儿___时间，我马上就好。
zh: 请给我一点儿时间，我马上就好。
py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī diǎn r shí jiān wǒ mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
en: Please give me a little time, I'll be ready in a moment.
why: 一点儿 takes no further measure, so 一点儿时间. 个, 段 and 份 cannot be added after it.

q: 我昨天在学校的书店买了一些___书。
zh: 我昨天在学校的书店买了一些书。
py: wǒ zuó tiān zài xué xiào de shū diàn mǎi le yī xiē shū
en: I bought some books at the school bookstore yesterday.
why: 一些 is itself the measure slot, so no other measure may follow it. 一些本书 and 一些个书 are wrong.

q: 我同事的猫上个月生了三___小猫，他想送给朋友。
zh: 我同事的猫上个月生了三只小猫，他想送给朋友。
py: wǒ tóng shì de māo shàng gè yuè shēng le sān zhī xiǎo māo tā xiǎng sòng gěi péng yǒu
en: My colleague's cat had three kittens last month, and he wants to give them to friends.
why: A cat is a small animal, so 只. 头 is for cattle and pigs, 匹 for horses and 辆 for vehicles.

s: 昨天晚上学校礼堂有一节音乐会，我和同学都去了。
s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xué xiào lǐ táng yǒu yī jié yīn yuè huì wǒ hé tóng xué dōu qù le
zh: 昨天晚上学校礼堂有一场音乐会，我和同学都去了。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xué xiào lǐ táng yǒu yī chǎng yīn yuè huì wǒ hé tóng xué dōu qù le
en: There was a concert in the school hall last night and my classmates and I all went.
why: A concert is an event that takes place, counted with 场. 节 is only for class periods.

q: 服务员，请再给我一___筷子。
zh: 服务员，请再给我一双筷子。
py: fú wù yuán qǐng zài gěi wǒ yī shuāng kuài zi
en: Waiter, please give me another pair of chopsticks.
why: Chopsticks come in twos and take 双. 杯, 碗 and 瓶 are containers.

q: 我的运动鞋坏了，得买一___新的。
zh: 我的运动鞋坏了，得买一双新的。
py: wǒ de yùn dòng xié huài le děi mǎi yī shuāng xīn de
en: My trainers are worn out, I have to buy a new pair.
why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双. 件 is for tops and 条 for trousers.

q: 我每天睡七___小时，所以白天不困。
zh: 我每天睡七个小时，所以白天不困。
py: wǒ měi tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí suǒ yǐ bái tiān bù kùn
en: I sleep seven hours every day, so I am not sleepy in the daytime.
why: 小时 is a noun and takes 个: 七个小时. 些, 次 and 位 do not count hours.

zh: 请给我一张纸。
py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng zhǐ
en: Please give me a sheet of paper.
why: Number + measure + noun comes after the verb 给我. The measure 张 stays between 一 and 纸.

s: 我们班有二十学生。
s_py: wǒ men bān yǒu èr shí xué shēng
zh: 我们班有二十个学生。
py: wǒ men bān yǒu èr shí gè xué shēng
en: There are twenty students in our class.
why: A number cannot sit directly on 学生; it needs the measure 个: 二十个学生.

q: 这个学期我选了五___课：汉语、数学、历史……
zh: 这个学期我选了五门课：汉语、数学、历史……
py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ xuǎn le wǔ mén kè ： hàn yǔ 、 shù xué 、 lì shǐ ……
en: This term I chose five courses: Chinese, maths, history and so on.
why: Courses are counted with 门. The listed subjects show different courses, not class periods, so 节 fails.

q: 我去过两___北京，都是出差。
zh: 我去过两次北京，都是出差。
py: wǒ qù guò liǎng cì běi jīng dōu shì chū chāi
en: I have been to Beijing twice, both times on business.
why: Counting how often something happened takes 次. 遍 needs something gone through from start to finish, and 个 cannot count times.

q: 我渴了，去买两___水。
zh: 我渴了，去买两瓶水。
py: wǒ kě le qù mǎi liǎng píng shuǐ
en: I'm thirsty, I'll go and buy two bottles of water.
why: Water you buy comes in a bottle: 瓶. 碗 is for food in bowls, 双 for pairs and 套 for sets.

q: 公司给每位新同事发了一___文具，里面有笔和本子。
zh: 公司给每位新同事发了一套文具，里面有笔和本子。
py: gōng sī gěi měi wèi xīn tóng shì fā le yī tào wén jù lǐ miàn yǒu bǐ hé běn zi
en: The company gave every new colleague a stationery set with pens and notebooks.
why: A set of items belonging together takes 套. 双 needs exactly two, 杯 and 瓶 are containers.

zh: 昨天下了一场大雨。
py: zuó tiān xià le yī cháng dà yǔ
en: There was a heavy rain yesterday.
why: 场 counts a fall of rain as an event and sits between 一 and 大雨.

q: 他新买了一___车，每天开车上班。
zh: 他新买了一辆车，每天开车上班。
py: tā xīn mǎi le yī liàng chē měi tiān kāi chē shàng bān
en: He has bought a new car and drives to work every day.
why: Anything on wheels takes 辆. 只, 条 and 匹 count animals.

s: 同事们从图书馆借走了一些本书，桌子上只剩两本。
s_py: tóng shì men cóng tú shū guǎn jiè zǒu le yī xiē běn shū zhuō zi shàng zhǐ shèng liǎng běn
zh: 同事们从图书馆借走了一些书，桌子上只剩两本。
py: tóng shì men cóng tú shū guǎn jiè zǒu le yī xiē shū zhuō zi shàng zhǐ shèng liǎng běn
en: The colleagues borrowed some books from the library and only two are left on the table.
why: 一些 already acts as the measure, so no 本 follows it: 一些书. 本 reappears only with a number, as in 两本.

q: 我们打算租一___两室一厅的房子。
zh: 我们打算租一套两室一厅的房子。
py: wǒ men dǎ suàn zū yī tào liǎng shì yī tīng de fáng zi
en: We plan to rent a two-bedroom flat.
why: A flat is a set of rooms and takes 套. 双 is for pairs, 杯 for cups and 块 for chunks.

q: 我们学校的院子里有两___鸟。
zh: 我们学校的院子里有两只鸟。
py: wǒ men xué xiào de yuàn zi lǐ yǒu liǎng zhǐ niǎo
en: There are two birds in our school's yard.
why: Small animals and birds take 只. 头 is for cattle and pigs, 匹 for horses, 条 for fish and snakes.

q: 在我看来，每___认真学习的学生都应该得到老师的表扬。
zh: 在我看来，每个认真学习的学生都应该得到老师的表扬。
py: zài wǒ kàn lái měi gè rèn zhēn xué xí de xué shēng dōu yīng gāi dé dào lǎo shī de biǎo yáng
en: In my view, every student who studies seriously deserves the teacher's praise.
why: 每 never touches a noun directly, even with a long modifier in between. 学生 takes 个; 每些 is not possible and 条 is for long things.

s: 我要一个杯咖啡，不要糖。
s_py: wǒ yào yí gè bēi kā fēi bú yào táng
zh: 我要一杯咖啡，不要糖。
py: wǒ yào yī bēi kā fēi bú yào táng
en: I'd like a cup of coffee, no sugar.
why: 杯 is already the measure, so 个 must not be added. 个 would only appear with the cup itself: 一个杯子.

s: 这篇课文我已经读了三遍，可是还有几个生词不懂。
s_py: zhè piān kè wén wǒ yǐ jīng dú le sān biàn kě shì hái yǒu jǐ gè shēng cí bù dǒng
zh: 这篇课文我已经读了三遍，可是还有几个生词不懂。
py: zhè piān kè wén wǒ yǐ jīng dú le sān biàn kě shì hái yǒu jǐ gè shēng cí bù dǒng
en: I have read this text three times already, but there are still a few new words I don't know.
why: Reading a text through is counted with 遍. The fronted object 这篇课文 is a normal pattern.

s: 我想喝一点儿水，再回去工作。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng hē yī diǎn r shuǐ zài huí qù gōng zuò
zh: 我想喝一点儿水，再回去工作。
py: wǒ xiǎng hē yī diǎn r shuǐ zài huí qù gōng zuò
en: I'd like a little water and then I'll go back to work.
why: 一点儿 goes straight onto the noun, so 一点儿水 is right with no measure like 杯.

zh: 我想买一些新书。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī xiē xīn shū
en: I want to buy some new books.
why: 一些 sits directly before the adjective and noun, with no other measure added.

q: 这___教学楼有六层，教室很多。
zh: 这座教学楼有六层，教室很多。
py: zhè zuò jiào xué lóu yǒu liù céng jiào shì hěn duō
en: This teaching building has six floors and lots of classrooms.
why: A building is a big fixed structure and takes 座. 家 is for businesses, 间 for single rooms and 口 for family members.

q: 学生们在教室里给李老师送了一___红花，还唱了一首歌。
zh: 学生们在教室里给李老师送了一朵红花，还唱了一首歌。
py: xué shēng men zài jiào shì lǐ gěi lǐ lǎo shī sòng le yī duǒ hóng huā hái chàng le yī shǒu gē
en: In the classroom the students gave Teacher Li a red flower and sang a song.
why: A flower takes 朵. 棵 is for whole plants and trees, 片 for slices, 块 for chunks.

zh: 办公室里有两台电脑。
py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu liǎng tái diàn nǎo
en: There are two computers in the office.
why: Place first, then 有, then number + 台 + noun. The measure 台 sits between 两 and 电脑.

s: 我的朋友在这个城市开了一间公司，生意很好。
s_py: wǒ de péng yǒu zài zhè ge chéng shì kāi le yī jiān gōng sī shēng yì hěn hǎo
zh: 我的朋友在这个城市开了一家公司，生意很好。
py: wǒ de péng yǒu zài zhè ge chéng shì kāi le yī jiā gōng sī shēng yì hěn hǎo
en: My friend opened a company in this city and business is good.
why: A company is a business and takes 家. 间 is for rooms.

q: 这个星期我们开了两___会，每次都很长。
zh: 这个星期我们开了两次会，每次都很长。
py: zhè ge xīng qī wǒ men kāi le liǎng cì huì měi cì dōu hěn cháng
en: We had two meetings this week, and each was long.
why: Occurrences take 次. A meeting is not read through (遍) or travelled to and fro (趟).

zh: 我借了三本书。
py: wǒ jiè le sān běn shū
en: I borrowed three books.
why: Number, then measure, then noun: 三本书. The measure cannot be left out or move behind the noun.

s: 办公室门口停着一只车。
s_py: bàn gōng shì mén kǒu tíng zhe yī zhī chē
zh: 办公室门口停着一辆车。
py: bàn gōng shì mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng chē
en: A car is parked at the office entrance.
why: A car runs on wheels and takes 辆. 只 is for small animals.

q: 我想订两___房间，住三天。
zh: 我想订两间房间，住三天。
py: wǒ xiǎng dìng liǎng jiān fáng jiān zhù sān tiān
en: I would like to book two rooms for three days.
why: Rooms are counted with 间. 家 is for businesses, 层 for floors, 座 for large buildings.

q: 他今天穿了一___新裤子去上班。
zh: 他今天穿了一条新裤子去上班。
py: tā jīn tiān chuān le yī tiáo xīn kù zi qù shàng bān
en: He wore a pair of new trousers to work today.
why: Trousers are long and bendy, so 条, not 件, which is for tops. 把 and 张 do not describe clothes.

q: 老师让我们把这篇课文从头到尾读三___。
zh: 老师让我们把这篇课文从头到尾读三遍。
py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men bǎ zhè piān kè wén cóng tóu dào wěi dú sān biàn
en: The teacher asked us to read this text through three times from beginning to end.
why: Going through a text from start to finish is 遍. 趟 is for trips, and 个 and 层 do not count actions.

q: 对不起，我没听清楚，请您再说一___。
zh: 对不起，我没听清楚，请您再说一遍。
py: duì bù qǐ wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ qǐng nín zài shuō yī biàn
en: Sorry, I didn't catch that, could you say it once more?
why: 遍 counts saying the whole thing through once more. 趟 is for a trip and 个 cannot count an action.

q: 下雨了，你带一___伞去学校吧。
zh: 下雨了，你带一把伞去学校吧。
py: xià yǔ le nǐ dài yī bǎ sǎn qù xué xiào ba
en: It's raining, take an umbrella to school.
why: An umbrella has a handle, so 把. 件 is for tops, 支 for pens and 条 for long bendy things.

q: 你更喜欢哪___词典，红的还是蓝的？
zh: 你更喜欢哪本词典，红的还是蓝的？
py: nǐ gèng xǐ huān nǎ běn cí diǎn hóng de hái shì lán de
en: Which dictionary do you like better, the red one or the blue one?
why: 哪 like 这 and 那 needs a measure before the noun, and a dictionary is a bound book: 本. 哪词典 leaves it out; 张 and 把 are for flat and gripped things.

q: 我们学校旁边新开了一___银行，办事很方便。
zh: 我们学校旁边新开了一家银行，办事很方便。
py: wǒ men xué xiào páng biān xīn kāi le yī jiā yín háng bàn shì hěn fāng biàn
en: A new bank has opened next to our school; it is convenient.
why: A bank is a business, so 家. 间 is for rooms, 座 for big fixed buildings and 层 for floors.

q: 我每___天都在图书馆学习。
zh: 我每天都在图书馆学习。
py: wǒ měi tiān dōu zài tú shū guǎn xué xí
en: I study in the library every day.
why: 天 is itself a measure, so 每天 takes no 个. 每个天 is wrong.

q: 我的书包里有两___词典。
zh: 我的书包里有两本词典。
py: wǒ de shū bāo lǐ yǒu liǎng běn cí diǎn
en: There are two dictionaries in my school bag.
why: A dictionary is a bound book, so 本. 张 is for flat sheets and 把 for things with a handle; 条 is for long bendy things.

zh: 他喝了两杯咖啡。
py: tā hē le liǎng bēi kā fēi
en: He drank two cups of coffee.
why: The container 杯 is the measure: 两杯咖啡, with no 个 and no 的.

q: 昨天下了一___大雨，我没去学校。
zh: 昨天下了一场大雨，我没去学校。
py: zuó tiān xià le yī cháng dà yǔ wǒ méi qù xué xiào
en: There was a heavy rain yesterday, so I did not go to school.
why: A fall of rain is an event that runs its course and takes 场. 顿 is for meals and 首 for songs.

q: 我今天早上给客户发了一___电子邮件。
zh: 我今天早上给客户发了一封电子邮件。
py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shàng gěi kè hù fā le yī fēng diàn zi yóu jiàn
en: This morning I sent a client an email.
why: Letters and emails are counted with 封. 张 is for flat sheets and 本 for books.

q: 我已经学了六___月汉语了，现在能和同事聊天。
zh: 我已经学了六个月汉语了，现在能和同事聊天。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng xué le liù gè yuè hàn yǔ le xiàn zài néng hé tóng shì liáo tiān
en: I have studied Chinese for six months now and can chat with colleagues.
why: 月 needs 个 when it counts a duration. 六月 without 个 means June, not six months.

q: 我想买两___衬衫去面试。
zh: 我想买两件衬衫去面试。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng jiàn chèn shān qù miàn shì
en: I want to buy two shirts to wear to the interview.
why: A shirt is a top, and tops take 件. 条 is for trousers and skirts; 张 is for flat sheets.

q: 请给我一___纸，我要写字。
zh: 请给我一张纸，我要写字。
py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng zhǐ wǒ yào xiě zì
en: Please give me a sheet of paper, I want to write.
why: Paper is flat, so it takes 张. 本 is for bound volumes, 条 for long bendy things and 把 for things you grip.

s: 他买了一件新裤子，准备明天上班穿。
s_py: tā mǎi le yī jiàn xīn kù zi zhǔn bèi míng tiān shàng bān chuān
zh: 他买了一条新裤子，准备明天上班穿。
py: tā mǎi le yī tiáo xīn kù zi zhǔn bèi míng tiān shàng bān chuān
en: He bought a new pair of trousers to wear to work tomorrow.
why: Trousers are long and bendy, so they take 条. 件 is for tops and matters.

q: 下午两点到两点四十五是第一___课，下课后休息十分钟。
zh: 下午两点到两点四十五是第一节课，下课后休息十分钟。
py: xià wǔ liǎng diǎn dào liǎng diǎn sì shí wǔ shì dì yī jié kè xià kè hòu xiū xī shí fēn zhōng
en: The first class runs from two to a quarter to three, and then there is a ten-minute break.
why: A slot in the timetable with a start and end time is a period: 节. 门 would name a subject.

q: 办公室里有三___电脑，都是新的。
zh: 办公室里有三台电脑，都是新的。
py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu sān tái diàn nǎo dōu shì xīn de
en: There are three computers in the office, all new.
why: Machines such as computers take 台. 辆 is for vehicles and 只 and 匹 are for animals.

q: 经理让我复印三___合同，下午要给客户。
zh: 经理让我复印三份合同，下午要给客户。
py: jīng lǐ ràng wǒ fù yìn sān fèn hé tóng xià wǔ yào gěi kè hù
en: The manager asked me to make three copies of the contract; they go to the client this afternoon.
why: Copies of a document are counted with 份. 本 is for bound books, 条 for long bendy things and 封 for letters.
